description: This file defines a PHP class MySQL80Platform that extends Doctrine's MySQL80Platform, overriding the hasNativeJsonType method to specify that native JSON types are not supported in this platform.

classes.name: MySQL80Platform
classes.description: A class extending Doctrine's MySQL80Platform with a custom implementation indicating JSON support limitation.

methods.name: hasNativeJsonType
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to return false, indicating that this platform does not support native JSON data types.
